signum.options.title: Signum
signum.option.optimize.tooltip: Draws the text of each sign side into a texture atlas once and then shows it as a single quad. Turn off to go back to vanilla sign text rendering. Takes effect immediately.
signum.option.debug_info.tooltip: Shows the Signum line on the F3 debug screen: atlas cells and pages, quads drawn and cells baked per second.
modmenu.summaryTranslation.signum: Draws sign text from a texture atlas: one quad per sign side.
modmenu.descriptionTranslation.signum: Vanilla lays out the text of every sign again each frame and draws at least two triangles per character. Signum draws the text of a sign side into a texture atlas cell once and then shows it as a single quad. Works with Iris shader packs.
